name: plainly covered — revision within the limit
scope:
WEB DESIGN AGREEMENT

1. Deliverables. Responsive designs for five (5) pages: Home, Shop, Product Detail, About, Contact. Delivered as Figma files plus exported image assets.
2. Revisions. The fee includes up to three (3) rounds of revisions across the five agreed page designs. A round means one consolidated set of feedback. Additional rounds are quoted separately.
3. Timeline. First designs within 10 working days of receiving brand assets and copy. Each revision round returned within 5 working days.
4. Not included. Front-end development, CMS implementation, copywriting, photography, illustration, logo or brand identity work, ongoing maintenance, and any page not listed in section 1.
5. Content. The Client provides all copy and photography.
request: Thanks for sending these over! A few notes on the Shop page — the product grid feels cramped and we'd like the filters moved to the left. That's our first proper round of feedback, everything else looks good.
